dossier_meta.context_text: The paper's lower bound for deterministic non-adaptive reconstruction ($\Omega(\Delta^{3}\log n/\log\Delta)$) is tied to a longstanding gap for cover-free families: $\Omega(r^{w+1}\log n/\log r)\leq t(n,w,r)\leq\mathcal{O}(r^{w+1}\log n)$. Closing this gap for $(1,r)$-cover-free families would directly improve the graph-reconstruction bounds.
